ScoreEntry.title: ScoreEntry
ScoreEntry.description: Completed 20-question Bible quiz score entry on the shared online leaderboard.

playerName.description: Display name chosen by the player.

playerAvatar.description: Emoji emblem chosen by the player.

score.description: Total points achieved in the 20-question round (0 to 3000).

correctAnswers.description: Number of correct answers out of 20 (0 to 20).

timeSpentSeconds.description: Time spent completing the round in seconds (0 to 86400).

isPublic.description: Whether the score is visible on the shared online leaderboard (always true).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded.

DuelRoom.title: DuelRoom
DuelRoom.description: Two-player simultaneous Bible quiz room sharing 20 identical questions.

difficulty.description: Selected difficulty level for the 20 shared questions.

questionIds.description: Exact ordered list of 20 question IDs from the 1,000-question bank.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the duel room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

startedAt.description: Server timestamp when the second player joined and the duel began.

DuelParticipant.title: DuelParticipant
DuelParticipant.description: Real-time progress, accuracy, and response-time metrics for one player in a 2-player duel.

slot.description: Player slot inside the duel room.

answeredCount.description: Number of answered questions so far (0 to 20).

correctAnswers.description: Number of correct answers so far (0 to 20).

totalTimeMs.description: Accumulated response time in milliseconds across answered questions.

avgResponseMs.description: Average response time in milliseconds per answered question.

answerTimesMs.description: Per-question response times in milliseconds (up to 20 entries).

answersCorrect.description: Per-question boolean correctness results (up to 20 entries).

finished.description: Whether the player has completed all 20 questions.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress update.

/scores/{scoreId}.description: Shared online leaderboard scores visible to all players.

/duels/{duelId}/participants/{slotId}.description: Host and guest real-time answer progress and response timings for a duel.
